title: Brick Client
description: A neoforge client that makes your game as solid as a brick! Recommended for powerful PC's
body:
Brick Client is a NeoForge-based Minecraft client for 1.21.11 (Mounts of Mayhem).

Solid. Stable. Optimized.

Includes:

Performance & Stability: Sodium + Sodium Extras + Reese’s Sodium Options, Lithium, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS, Entity Culling & More Culling.

Quality of Life: AppleSkin, Better Advancements, Better F3, Inventory HUD+, Mouse Tweaks, Controlling, Packet Fixer, Shulker Box Tooltip, Searchables.

Visuals / Shaders: Iris Shaders (optional), Unique Dark resource pack.

Config / Libraries: Cloth Config API, Forge Config API Port, YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL).

Everything is client-side only and fully compatible with NeoForge 1.21.11. Brick Client is designed to be solid as a brick, easy to use, and ready for all Forge mod adventures.

Optional features: Shaders, voice chat (Simple Voice Chat), and full configuration via Cloth Config API and YACL.
